meta.author: orchestrator
meta.coordinate_scheme: slice in {billing, scheduling, shared, app, <new-slice>}; layer in {core, data, ui, slice-root, primitives-ui, primitives-lib, primitives-http, app}
meta.note: Predictions are what I believe the constitution IMPLIES, derived from README constitution + rules 1-7 + existing code patterns. Contention notes flag where I expect subagents to disagree.

predictions.request: Apply a discount code to an invoice, reduces the total.
predictions.contention: LOW. README worked example #1 answers this near-verbatim. Answer key leaked in README.

predictions.request: Backend renames invoice API fields; line items nested one level deeper.
predictions.contention: LOW. Pure DTO reshape; 'DTOs stay home'. Core/ui must NOT change. This is a containment guarantee, not a placement puzzle.

predictions.request: Date-range filter atop invoice list AND appointment day view, same look/behaviour.
predictions.contention: HIGH. Genuine rule-7 vs worked-example-#3 conflict. Rule 7 + example-3 caveat say TWO usages => duplicate per slice (do NOT promote to shared until 3rd usage). But example #3 headline + 'same look/behaviour' tempts shared/ui/date-range-picker (primitives-ui). I predict duplication is the strictly-correct reading; I expect most subagents to pick shared/ui. This divergence is a primary finding.
predictions.leaked_in_readme: partial (example #3 covers the picker but caveats promotion)

predictions.request: Appointments show a coloured status label in day view, like invoices do.
predictions.contention: LOW-MED. Mirrors billing's InvoiceStatusBadge (rule 5: about scheduling => scheduling slice). Trap: a shared StatusBadge would be a domain-aware primitive (rule-7 violation, Phase-2 adversarial item). Correct = scheduling/ui.

predictions.request: On invoice detail page, show the client's next upcoming appointment.
predictions.contention: LOW. README worked example #2 answers this. Uses @slices/scheduling public surface (fetchUpcomingAppointments already exported). scheduling/index.ts unchanged (field exists). Answer key leaked in README.

predictions.request: Reschedule shows new time immediately (optimistic), rolls back on server reject.
predictions.contention: MED. Optimistic update = view-state concern => ui/composable. But 'a store is a cache with an IO habit => data/'; a subagent may introduce scheduling/data/store.ts. Scheduling has no store today. Predicted correct = scheduling/ui; data/ is the plausible divergence.

predictions.request: Compliance audit log of every change to invoices and appointments (who, when, what).
predictions.contention: VERY HIGH. Cross-cutting concern orthogonal to both axes. No rule adjudicates. Candidates: (a) new 'audit'/'compliance' slice invoked via public index by each slice's data/mutations; (b) app-level interceptor (but app is a leaf, imported by nobody -> cannot host a service slices call); (c) shared/ (blocked: domain-aware, rule 7); (d) each slice logs to its own data/ with a shared domain-free transport. 'who' (user identity) has no home. Expect wide scatter.

predictions.request: Statuses display in the user's language; launching German.
predictions.contention: VERY HIGH. i18n mechanism = domain-free primitive (shared/lib, like format.ts) + locale provider (app). But message catalogs contain domain nouns (invoice/appointment status labels) => must live per-slice ui, NOT shared (rule 7). Where catalogs live and whether status->label mapping moves out of the badges is unresolved. Expect scatter across shared/app/per-slice.

predictions.request: Only 'finance' role can void an invoice; others don't see the button.
predictions.contention: VERY HIGH. authz cross-cutting. void is billing (canVoid in billing/core/policy). Permission-to-void as a pure rule can extend billing/core/policy (role passed in). But 'current user + role' has no home: candidates app/providers, a new 'auth' slice, or shared (blocked: domain-ish). Whether canVoid takes a role or a separate guard exists is unresolved.

predictions.request: Turn the reschedule flow on/off per customer without deploying (feature flags).
predictions.contention: VERY HIGH. Feature-flag mechanism = domain-free => shared/lib OR app/providers. Per-customer evaluation needs customer context. Gating the reschedule button => scheduling/ui. shared-vs-app for the flag service is the split; some may put a flags store in data/ of a slice.

predictions.request: Billing periods: named date range grouping appointments + invoices, totals per period.
predictions.contention: VERY HIGH. New cross-slice business capability spanning billing + scheduling. Candidates: (a) new slice composing both via public indexes; (b) app/views (but constitution says ClientOverviewView is 'the ONLY cross-slice composition view'); (c) fold into billing (but it needs scheduling data). Slice name and whether it lives inside billing are contested. This tests domain-slice fit.

predictions.request: Search box on both list views, filters-as-you-type without hammering the server.
predictions.contention: MED. useDebounce already exists in shared/lib (reuse, no modify). Two list views => per-slice ui filter wiring. Rule 7: search input is 2 usages => duplicate, not shared. Divergence: a shared/ui SearchInput primitive; or reading 'without hammering the server' as server-side (data/ query change).
